_comment: Setup value space per lever for the setup engine: typical-window nominal + span (soft edge, 'engineer may exceed') and edge exemptions. Hard edges stay in setup_parameters.json value_space.
_comment_parameter_windows: One entry per registry key (46). nominal + span from the registry's typical_window/value_space: span = half the typical window width (one-sided, e.g. arb_fl 4 +/- 1 from 3..5); no typical window -> nominal = value_space midpoint, span = half the legal range (wider, weaker, flagged). Plain enums without an underlying number stay null (arb_front_mount, wing_position). Null window or non-numeric current value -> neutral headroom term.

arb_front_mount.note: Unfillable: no numeric quantity underlies this enum (car_data.json 'arb' is blade stiffness by position 1-7, a different parameter from the P0/P1/P2 mount-point selection); an enum-index midpoint would have no physical referent, same category as abs_position.

springs_front.source: 2026-09-18: value_space.options=[220,250,280,310] N/mm (a NUMERIC enum, unlike arb_front_mount/wing_position) -- nominal=range midpoint (220+310)/2, span=half-width (310-220)/2. Not one of the 4 legal option values itself (no option sits at the midpoint) -- stated as the window CENTRE for distance purposes, not a recommendable setting.

springs_rear.source: 2026-09-18: value_space.options=[240,260,280,300] N/mm -- nominal=(240+300)/2, span=(300-240)/2. Same non-option-value caveat as springs_front.

damper_bump_ls_fl.source: typical_window.reference_point_NBR=10; span=fallback (2026-09-18), HALF the full legal value_space range (0-18 clicks)/2=9 -- no team-typical SPAN exists, only the reference point, so this is deliberately a wide, weak window (the full legal range), not a real team-typical tolerance.

damper_bump_hs_fl.source: typical_window.reference_point_NBR=14; span=half the full legal range (0-18)/2=9, same fallback as damper_bump_ls_fl.

damper_blowoff_fl.source: typical_window.reference_point_NBR=6; span=half the full legal range (0-18)/2=9, same fallback.

damper_rebound_hs_fl.source: typical_window.reference_point_NBR=8; span=half the full legal range (0-18)/2=9, same fallback.

ride_height_front.note: the registry gives a floor only (standard - 2 mm, diffuser floor limit; no upper limit, author ruling); the symmetric span here only drives the headroom tie-break and the soft 'engineer may exceed' note, it never blocks a step

diff_package.note: context-only, recommendation_target=false -- not a setup-engine lever

diff_position.source: 2026-09-18: no typical_window nominal exists, so nominal=value_space range midpoint (1+5)/2=3 (supersedes the earlier policy of leaving a plain midpoint null); span=half the full range (5-1)/2=2.

wing_position.note: Unfillable in current form: a physical anchor exists (setup_parameters.json angles_deg [7.3, 8.3, 9.3], midpoint 8.3 deg = option P9), but Outing.setup_data stores the enum label ('P9'), not the angle, so a nominal/span in degrees would compare against a different representation. A working window needs a label -> angle mapping in code first; left null.

camber_fl.source: typical_window.base=-3.5; span=fallback (2026-09-18), half the full legal value_space range (-4.8 to -2.0 deg)/2=1.4 -- no team-typical span exists, only the base value, so this is deliberately the full legal range, not a real tolerance.

camber_fr.source: typical_window.base=-3.5; span=half the full legal range (-4.8 to -2.0)/2=1.4, same fallback as camber_fl.

camber_rl.source: typical_window.base=-3.2; span=half the full legal range (-4.8 to -2.0)/2=1.4, same fallback.

camber_rr.source: typical_window.base=-3.2; span=half the full legal range (-4.8 to -2.0)/2=1.4, same fallback.

tc_lat.source: typical_window.baseline=5 ('normal conditions'); span=fallback (2026-09-18), half the full legal value_space range (0-11)/2=5.5 -- no team-typical span exists, only the baseline, so this is deliberately the full legal range.

tc_lon.source: typical_window.baseline=5 ('normal conditions'); span=half the full legal range (0-11)/2=5.5, same fallback as tc_lat.

abs_position.note: categorical, not one monotonic axis (registry direction_semantics.type) -- a nominal + span distance does not apply; the window headroom term is neutral for this lever.

brake_bias.note: Recommendation target (setup_parameters.json); nominal/span stay null because the current value is not evaluable until the brake-bias channel is identified (setup_parameters.json brake_bias notes).

splitter_offset.source: config/setup_parameters.json splitter_offset value_space {min:-4, max:4, step:1 mm, default:0} and typical_window = full legal range (sign convention author-elicited 2026-09-22): nominal = default = range midpoint 0, span = half-width 4. Filled 2026-09-26 so headroom is evaluable for splitter, a lever the author named for it. The hard forward edge (negative extreme, splitter/track contact, track-dependent) stays with the window-edge labels, not with this distance.

_comment_edge_normal_state_params: Edge exemptions per (parameter, direction) where the edge is the lever's normal resting state -- e.g. ride_height_front pinned at its lower limit. Standing practice lands here, never as an edit to an engineer-verbatim rule. Exempt edge: no blocked_at_edge, candidate stays proposed with an edge_normal_state_note (live value filled in); other actions still checked and can block. Only 'decrease' for ride_height_front; moving off the pin is an ordinary move.
